workload: Gram matrix tdot_blas(X) for X 1800 by 8 float64, the shape Linear.K and stationary self-distances use at N=1800.
notes: Peak is 64898327 bytes versus one 1800^2 float64 Gram (25920000). The extra ~37 MiB is the pair of triu_indices buffers inside symmetrify (n*(n-1)/2 intp each) held with the Gram, then ascontiguousarray copies the result. On this host np.dot(X, X.T) peaks at one Gram and ran in ~5.5 ms against ~46 ms for tdot_blas, so a local change in tdot_blas can return a C-contiguous symmetric product without those index vectors. Five tracemalloc peaks: 64898327, 64898327, 64898280, 64898327, 64898327; noise is (max-min)/median. Overlap: no open SheffieldML/GPy PRs; dexhunter's only PR is merged #1272 (Gaussian.samples), not this file; merged PRs since 2026-10-16 do not edit tdot_blas (#1299 is psi chunking, #1274 is util test collection). CIP-000E (Proposed, not accepted) names symmetrify itself for a possible Cython rewrite; this target is the caller, which can avoid that cost without editing the Cython modules CIP-000E lists. No open issue marks linalg.py as being moved.

workload: Cross distances between 1800 training rows and 1800 test rows in 8 dimensions (RBF prediction / K(X, X2), not the self-Gram path).
notes: The X2 branch does not call tdot. It builds r2 = -2*X@X2.T + (x1sq[:,None] + x2sq[None,:]), then clip, then sqrt, so two full 1800^2 matrices are live (peak 51986344 versus the 25920000-byte result). Fusing the scale, add, clip, and sqrt into one buffer removes about 25 MiB. Five identical tracemalloc peaks. Kernel gradient checks call K(X, X2), which hits this branch. Overlap: no open PRs; #1223 and #1224 only changed the ExpQuad docstring and Stationary.__init__ (abstract guard), not _unscaled_dist; #1276 added kernel tests without editing this method; dexhunter #1272 is Gaussian.samples. CIP-000E targets lengthscale grads and gradients_X, not the distance helper. lfm1 deprecation does not apply.

workload: One log-concave Laplace Newton step at N=1000: dense prior K plus a positive diagonal negative Hessian W.
notes: tracemalloc peak is exactly eight n by n float64 matrices (64000000 bytes plus small headers). The function returns three matrices (K_Wi_i, I_KW_i, Ki_W_i). The other five are eye(N), the two broadcast products in W**(1/2)*K*W**(1/2).T, diagflat(W), and the dtrtrs/dot temporaries. Building B in one scaled copy and applying the diagonal without a dense diagflat drops on the order of 40 MiB on every Newton iteration. Five identical peaks. Covered by Gamma, Student-T, and Poisson Laplace tests. Overlap: no open PRs; no merged PR in the last 30 days edits laplace.py; dexhunter #1272 does not. CIP-000E explicitly leaves inference algorithms out of its Cython scope. Not deprecated.

workload: pdinv of a 1000 by 1000 positive definite covariance, the matrix exact Gaussian inference factorizes on each marginal likelihood call.
notes: The harness copies the input inside the call, matching ExactGaussianInference (Ky = K.copy() before pdinv). Three returned matrices plus that copy are 32 MiB; the measured peak is 43993263 (~42 MiB). The extra ~12 MiB is a second Fortran copy of the Cholesky (jitchol returns C order, then dtrtri and dpotri each call force_F_ordered) together with symmetrify's triu index buffer while Ai, L, and Li are live. Factoring once in F order and mirroring the triangle without an n^2/2 index vector is a local pdinv change. Five identical peaks. test_setXY builds a GPRegression and checkgrad, which calls ExactGaussianInference.inference and thus pdinv. Overlap: no open PRs; linalg.py was not edited by merged PRs since 2026-10-16; dexhunter #1272 is Gaussian.samples. CIP-000E names symmetrify, not pdinv, and is still Proposed. jitchol's success path is nearly in place and was not selected.
